func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
	utils.InitLoggerForTests()
	os.Exit(m.Run())
}

func TestTeleportProxySSH(t *testing.T) {
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	mux, err := New(Config{Listener: listener})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	sshListener := mux.SSH()
	go mux.Serve()
	defer mux.Close()

	client, err := net.Dial("tcp", listener.Addr().String())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer client.Close()

	hello := []byte(apiSSHUtils.ProxyHelloSignature + `{"clientAddr":"192.0.2.10:1234","tracingContext":{"trace":"test"}}` + "\x00SSH-2.0-test\r\n")
	_, err = client.Write(hello)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	accepted := make(chan net.Conn, 1)
	go func() {
		conn, err := sshListener.Accept()
		if err == nil {
			accepted <- conn
		}
	}()
	select {
	case conn := <-accepted:
		defer conn.Close()
		require.Equal(t, ProtoSSH, conn.(*Conn).Protocol())
		require.Equal(t, "192.0.2.10:1234", conn.RemoteAddr().String())
		read := make([]byte, len(hello))
		_, err = io.ReadFull(conn, read)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.True(t, bytes.Equal(hello, read))
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("prefixed SSH connection was not routed to the SSH listener")
	}
}

func TestTeleportProxySSHWithoutClientAddr(t *testing.T) {
	client, server := net.Pipe()
	defer client.Close()
	defer server.Close()
	hello := []byte(apiSSHUtils.ProxyHelloSignature + `{"tracingContext":{"trace":"test"}}` + "\x00SSH-2.0-test\r\n")
	go func() {
		client.Write(hello)
		client.Close()
	}()
	conn, err := detect(server, false)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, ProtoSSH, conn.Protocol())
	require.Equal(t, server.RemoteAddr().String(), conn.RemoteAddr().String())
	read, err := io.ReadAll(conn)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, hello, read)
}

item.text:
The SSH multiplexer now routes `Teleport-Proxy` connections with null-terminated JSON as SSH. When the payload contains `ClientAddr`, the connection exposes it through `RemoteAddr()`. The prefix is replayed so the SSH server can read its metadata; standard SSH behavior remains covered by the existing tests.

Validation passed: `go test ./lib/multiplexer -count=1` and `git diff --check`.
